_comment: This is an example configuration file. Copy to config.json and modify paths as needed.
_epsg_comment: Common EPSG codes: 2224 (NAD83 State Plane), 4326 (WGS84), 3857 (Web Mercator)
_points_comment: Set to true to create FLO-2D grid points shapefile with flow direction
_style_comment: Path to folder containing QML style files for QGIS. Leave empty if not using styles.
_format_comment: Options: 'Shapefile' or 'GeoPackage'. GeoPackage recommended for better performance.
